$comment: Public share links for an asset. The token is the slug in /s/{token}; the cleanup function removes expired links (chapter 9), and a function resolves them (chapter 5) so anonymous readers never enumerate this collection.

token.description: Random, unguessable; the public URL is /s/{token}.

expires_at.description: null means the link never expires.

created_by.description: User id of who minted the link (the share function writes as admin, so _meta.owner isn't it).
